Noah Rivera: Hey finance team — hotel charged a $65 'Lost Ticket Fee' after I misplaced the valet stub on 03/18. Corporate card declined at checkout so I paid on my personal card. Can this be reimbursed? I uploaded the folio and a photo of the receipt.
Finance Ops: Thanks Noah. Lost valet fees are usually reviewed case-by-case. Can you add the folio number and name of the hotel here? Also which project should this be charged to if approved?
Noah Rivera: Folio #842719, Hotel Meridian - SF. Charged $65 on my personal card. Need to charge to project TRAVEL-Q2 if approved. Photo attached (jpeg). Merchant line shows "VAL LOST".
Finance Ops: OK — policy note: incidental fees (towels, minibar, parking) are generally reimbursable, but "lost ticket" fees require manager attestation because sometimes they're treated as personal negligence. @Aisha (manager) can you confirm approval for Noah?
Aisha (manager): Saw the folio, totally fine — team had back-to-back client calls, looks like an honest mistake. Approving reimbursement for $65. :thumbsup:
Finance Ops: Thanks Aisha — noted approval. Noah, please update the expense in Concur/Expenses and attach the folio + the photo. Use expense type "Parking - Incidental" and tag with project code TRAVEL-Q2. Also mark as "manager-approved" in the notes.
Noah Rivera: Done — uploaded files and added note: "manager approved via slack 2339001234". Submitted for payment.
Expenses Bot: Expense submitted. Status: Pending manual review. Reminder: reimbursements paid on payroll schedule; expect reimbursement in next cycle after verification.
Finance Ops: Received the submission. We'll reconcile and push to payment queue. If anything else is missing we'll ping here. Thanks.
